paper_main_benchmark.description: Paper headline benchmark on 1125 non-tight disjunctive ASP instances, 5000s timeout and 8 GB memory.

solved_instances.description: Number of benchmark instances solved within the paper's resource limits.

par2.description: Paper-reported penalized average runtime, retained as reference context only because wall-clock metrics are hardware dependent.

paper_hybrid_benchmark.description: Paper hybrid benchmark using clingo enumeration up to 10000 answer sets followed by a counter fallback.

solved_instances.description: Number of hybrid benchmark instances solved within the paper's resource limits.

par2.description: Paper-reported penalized average runtime, retained as reference context only because wall-clock metrics are hardware dependent.

scaled_disjunctive_counting.description: Scaled reproduction target with exact counts on generated non-tight disjunctive programs derived from the paper example.

solved_instances.description: Number of split instances for which the artifact reports a complete count.

exact_count_accuracy.description: Fraction of split instances whose complete reported answer-set count exactly matches the known count.

large_exact_count_accuracy.description: Exact-count accuracy restricted to instances above the 1000-answer-set enumeration cap.

small_exact_count_accuracy.description: Exact-count accuracy on instances at or below the 1000-answer-set enumeration cap.

answer_set_log2_mae.description: Mean absolute log2 error of reported counts, with missing or incomplete results receiving a finite miss penalty.

max_log2_count_solved.description: Largest log2 answer-set count among split instances reported as complete.

avg_loop_atoms.description: Average reported loop-atom count, kept as a small encoding-cost signal rather than a primary objective.

avg_auxiliary_to_core_clause_ratio.description: Average reported ratio of auxiliary encoding clauses to core encoding clauses, used as a lightweight formula-growth constraint.

structural_report_fraction.description: Fraction of split instances reporting loop and formula-size fields so missing structural data cannot look like zero cost.

scaled_hybrid_counting.description: Scaled reproduction target for the hybrid claim: enumerate small-count cases, then fall back to an exact counter when enumeration exceeds the cap.

solved_instances.description: Number of split instances for which the hybrid artifact reports a complete count.

exact_count_accuracy.description: Fraction of split instances whose complete hybrid count exactly matches the known count.

large_exact_count_accuracy.description: Hybrid exact-count accuracy restricted to instances above the 1000-answer-set enumeration cap.

small_exact_count_accuracy.description: Hybrid exact-count accuracy on instances at or below the 1000-answer-set enumeration cap.

answer_set_log2_mae.description: Mean absolute log2 error of hybrid reported counts, with missing or incomplete results receiving a finite miss penalty.

max_log2_count_solved.description: Largest log2 answer-set count among split instances reported as complete by the hybrid artifact.

enumeration_completed_instances.description: Number of complete split instances handled without invoking the fallback counter.

fallback_instances.description: Number of split instances reported as requiring the fallback counter.

avg_loop_atoms.description: Average reported loop-atom count for fallback-style encodings, kept as a small encoding-cost signal.

avg_auxiliary_to_core_clause_ratio.description: Average reported ratio of auxiliary encoding clauses to core encoding clauses, used as a lightweight formula-growth constraint.

structural_report_fraction.description: Fraction of split instances reporting loop and formula-size fields so missing structural data cannot look like zero cost.
